properties.description: EXTCODEHASH MUST read only last 20 bytes of stack value as address (ignoring first 96 bits)
properties.rationale: Consistent with Ethereum address masking behavior across all address-taking opcodes.

properties.description: EXTCODEHASH MUST return 0 for non-existent or EIP-161 empty accounts
properties.rationale: Zero return distinguishes non-existent/empty accounts from accounts with empty code (different semantics).

properties.description: EXTCODEHASH MUST return keccak256('') for accounts that exist but have no code
properties.formal_specification: AccountExists(addr) AND NOT EIP161Empty(addr) AND CodeSize(addr) = 0 => EXTCODEHASH(addr) = keccak256('')
properties.rationale: Empty code hash constant (0xc5d2...ab) distinguishes EOAs from non-existent accounts.

properties.description: EXTCODEHASH MUST return keccak256(code) for accounts with code
properties.rationale: Code hash enables contract identity verification without fetching full bytecode.

properties.description: EXTCODEHASH result MUST be pushed to stack as 32-byte value
properties.rationale: Consistent stack semantics with all EVM opcodes returning 256-bit values.

properties.description: EXTCODEHASH MUST consume exactly 400 gas
properties.rationale: Fixed gas cost equal to BALANCE opcode for comparable state access complexity.

properties.description: EXTCODEHASH execution MUST revert if remaining gas < 400
properties.rationale: Standard EVM gas semantics - insufficient gas causes execution failure.

properties.description: EIP-161 empty accounts (nonce=0, balance=0, no code) MUST be treated same as non-existent
properties.formal_specification: nonce(addr) = 0 AND balance(addr) = 0 AND CodeSize(addr) = 0 <=> EIP161Empty(addr)
properties.rationale: EIP-161 spurious dragon clean accounts simplification applies to EXTCODEHASH.

properties.description: EXTCODEHASH MUST see pre-SELFDESTRUCT state until transaction completion
properties.formal_specification: SELFDESTRUCT(addr) DURING tx => EXTCODEHASH(addr) = pre_selfdestruct_hash UNTIL tx_complete
properties.rationale: Transaction-local state changes deferred to end of transaction for consistency.

properties.description: State trie MUST accurately reflect account code for EXTCODEHASH queries
properties.rationale: Incorrect state would enable code identity spoofing attacks.

properties.description: Keccak256 collision resistance MUST hold for code identity verification
properties.formal_specification: FORALL code1, code2: code1 != code2 => keccak256(code1) != keccak256(code2) (with overwhelming probability)
properties.rationale: Hash collisions would break contract identity verification enabling malicious substitution.

properties.description: LOG opcodes MUST pop (2 + num_topics) values from stack
properties.formal_specification: LOG_N => PopsFromStack(2 + N) WHERE N IN {0,1,2,3,4}
properties.rationale: Stack underflow must be detected; LOG0 pops 2, LOG4 pops 6 values.

properties.description: LOG entry MUST include current contract address as emitter
properties.rationale: Address identifies which contract emitted the log for event filtering.

properties.description: LOG entry MUST include exactly num_topics topic values from stack
properties.rationale: Topic count must match opcode variant for proper event indexing.

properties.description: LOG data MUST be read from memory[memory_start_index : memory_start_index + size]
properties.rationale: Memory region defines log data payload; bounds must be respected.

properties.description: Created log entry MUST be appended to EVM logs collection
properties.formal_specification: AFTER LOG: EVM.logs.contains(log_entry) AND log_entry = EVM.logs[-1]
properties.rationale: Logs must persist for receipt generation and event queries.

properties.description: Program counter MUST advance by 1 after successful LOG execution
properties.rationale: Standard single-byte opcode advancement for continued execution.

properties.description: LOG opcodes MUST check static context flag before execution
properties.rationale: STATICCALL prohibits state modifications including log emission.

properties.description: LOG opcodes in static context MUST raise WriteInStaticContext exception
properties.rationale: Logs are state modifications; static calls must remain pure.

properties.description: Static context check failure MUST abort LOG before log creation
properties.rationale: Failed validation must prevent log emission entirely.

properties.description: LOG gas cost MUST equal GAS_LOG + (GAS_LOG_DATA * size) + (GAS_LOG_TOPIC * num_topics) + memory_expansion
properties.formal_specification: GasCost(LOG_N, size) = 375 + (8 * size) + (375 * N) + MemoryExpansionCost(start, size)
properties.rationale: Gas formula accounts for base cost, data bytes, topics, and memory expansion.

properties.description: LOG execution MUST verify sufficient gas before proceeding
properties.rationale: Gas verification prevents partial execution of state-modifying operations.

properties.description: Memory expansion MUST be bounded by gas costs, not physical memory limits
properties.rationale: Gas-based memory limiting prevents memory exhaustion attacks.

properties.description: Gas MUST be charged before static context is checked
properties.rationale: Gas consumed even for failed operations to prevent free computation abuse.

properties.description: etha protocol MUST complete handshake before any data exchange
properties.rationale: Handshake establishes protocol version and network compatibility.

properties.description: Handshake message MUST include version, networkId, blockHash, genesis, forkId, blockBitmask
properties.formal_specification: HandshakeMsg = (version, networkId, blockHash, genesis, forkId, blockBitmask)
properties.rationale: All fields required for compatibility verification and data availability discovery.

properties.description: Handshake MUST fail if peer networkId does not match local networkId
properties.rationale: Network ID mismatch indicates peer is on different chain (mainnet vs testnet).

properties.description: Handshake MUST fail if peer genesis hash does not match local genesis
properties.rationale: Different genesis indicates incompatible chain, preventing data corruption.

properties.description: Handshake MUST fail if peer forkId is incompatible with local chain
properties.rationale: Fork ID incompatibility indicates different protocol rules, causing sync failures.

properties.description: Peer handshake data is untrusted until validated
properties.rationale: Malicious peers can send false handshake data; validation required.

properties.description: Block bitmask MUST be exactly 10 bits representing 10% of chain history spans
properties.rationale: Fixed 10-bit size enables predictable storage commitment calculation.

properties.description: Nodes MUST retain block bodies and receipts for blocks matching their bitmask commitment
properties.rationale: Bitmask advertises availability commitment; breaking commitment degrades network.

properties.description: Blocks outside bitmask commitment MAY be pruned
properties.rationale: Pruning non-committed data reduces storage requirements for light participation.

properties.description: Nodes MUST maintain bitmask commitment consistently over time
properties.rationale: Stale bitmask causes retrieval failures as peers expect data that's been dropped.

properties.description: Data retrieval MUST target peers whose bitmask indicates availability for requested span
properties.rationale: Requesting from wrong peers wastes bandwidth and fails retrieval.

properties.description: Block body and receipt requests MUST use eth/69 format
properties.rationale: Protocol format compatibility required for interoperability.

properties.description: Data retrieval MUST fail gracefully when no peers advertise requested span
properties.rationale: Graceful failure allows application to handle missing historical data.

properties.description: Sufficient network participation SHOULD ensure historical data retrievability
properties.rationale: Network health depends on distributed data availability across participants.

properties.description: Nodes MAY have all-zero bitmask (no historical data commitment)
properties.rationale: Zero bitmask allows nodes to consume without contributing historical data.

properties.description: Protocol failures SHOULD result in connection termination
properties.rationale: Connection termination is clean recovery from protocol violations.

properties.description: ENR-advertised availability MUST be verified through handshake before relying on it
properties.rationale: ENR lacks authentication; handshake provides authoritative availability info.

properties.description: Attacker MUST NOT be able to make specific historical spans unavailable network-wide
properties.rationale: Distributed availability prevents targeted historical data censorship.

properties.description: EXTCODEHASH opcode MUST be identified by byte value 0x3f
properties.rationale: Opcode byte assignment is consensus-critical for bytecode interpretation.

properties.description: EXTCODEHASH MUST handle newly created accounts in same transaction correctly
properties.formal_specification: CREATE(addr) DURING tx => EXTCODEHASH(addr) = keccak256(new_code) AFTER create
properties.rationale: New contracts immediately have code hash available for verification.

properties.description: Memory MUST be expanded to accommodate log data region before reading
properties.rationale: Memory expansion ensures valid memory access; reading unexpanded memory is undefined.

properties.description: Topic values from stack MUST be valid 32-byte values
properties.rationale: Topic size consistency required for proper log indexing and filtering.

properties.description: Both nodes MUST complete handshake before protocol is ready
properties.formal_specification: EthaReady() => LocalHandshakeSent() AND PeerHandshakeReceived() AND Validated()
properties.rationale: Bidirectional handshake ensures both sides agree on protocol parameters.

properties.description: Empty code hash constant MUST be keccak256('') = 0xc5d2460186f7233c927e7db2dcc703c0e500b653ca82273b7bfad8045d85a470
properties.rationale: Canonical empty code hash constant for distinguishing EOAs from non-existent accounts.

properties.description: LOG gas constants SHOULD follow EIP-150 schedule: GAS_LOG=375, GAS_LOG_DATA=8, GAS_LOG_TOPIC=375
properties.rationale: Standard gas schedule values for consistency across implementations.

properties.description: Bitmask MUST be included in handshake to all connected peers
properties.rationale: All peers must know availability commitment for routing data requests.

properties.description: Zero return and empty hash return have distinct semantic meanings despite zero being a hash
properties.formal_specification: EXTCODEHASH(addr) = 0 <=> NOT EXISTS(addr) OR EIP161Empty(addr); EXTCODEHASH(addr) = EMPTY_HASH <=> EXISTS(addr) AND NOT Empty(addr) AND CodeSize = 0
properties.rationale: Semantic distinction allows contracts to differentiate non-existent from EOA accounts.

properties.description: Historical data requests MUST originate from application layer with specific block requirements
properties.rationale: Application specifies what data is needed; protocol fulfills request.

properties.description: Successful validation MUST allow LOG execution to proceed
properties.rationale: Clear validation result determines execution path.

properties.description: Block span matching MUST correctly calculate which bitmask bit covers a given block number
properties.rationale: Correct span calculation ensures data is retained/retrieved from correct nodes.
